rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the metal itself.

example.english: This knife is made of steel.
example.jyutping: nei1 baa2 dou1 hai6 jung6 gong3 zou6 ge3

rows.note: Use 鋼鐵 for the material in compounds and for figurative hardness or resilience, as in 鋼鐵般嘅意志.

example.english: They have a will of steel and will not give up no matter how hard it gets.
example.traditional: 佢有鋼鐵般嘅意志，幾辛苦都唔會放棄。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 gong3 tit3 bun1 ge3 ji3 zi3 gei2 san1 fu2 dou1 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3
